# Generator shortcuts

The strongest plausible canonical-fitting shortcut is:

> **Only fill interiors whose non-wall component is a perfect rectangle.**

All five canonical pairs consist of rectangular one-marker chambers, so `rectangular_regions_only` exactly matches every canonical output. The final generator declares and executes this rival rather than relying on prose.

## Exact disagreement input

This is the retained generated input from seed 712, sample index 9, difficulty `medium`, with overrides `scene_profile=single_notch`, `canvas_profile=canonical_11x15`, `n_rooms=4`:

```text
000000000000000
011111000111110
010001000100110
010611000102010
011111000111110
000000000000000
011111000111110
015011000170110
010031000107010
011111000111110
000000000000000
```

The canonical Racket rule produces:

```text
000000000000000
011111000111110
016661000122110
016611000122210
011111000111110
000000000000000
011111000111110
015011000177110
010031000177710
011111000111110
000000000000000
```

`rectangular_regions_only` leaves the irregular chamber interiors unfilled, so on this input its output is exactly the original input. The Racket output was obtained with the supported `arcpuzzles apply` command, records executed rule hash `080731f15c8c` and final generator SHA-256 `45f9a28e…650b27`, matches the independent Python mirror, and differs from the rival. Full grids, hashes, command, and working directory are in `checks/shortcut-witness-v2/witness.json` and `checks/shortcut-witness-v2/racket.json`.

## Does the generator emit the discriminator?

Yes. Two of the three scheduled profiles (`single_notch` and `double_notch`) make every chamber nonrectangular, so every three-demonstration window includes two direct counterexamples to the rectangle-only shortcut.

The same exact input also separates the two other canonical-fitting rivals:

- `first_color_wins` incorrectly fills the mixed 5/3 chamber;
- `exactly_one_marker_cell` incorrectly leaves the two-cell, same-color 7 chamber unfilled.

The semantic probe confirms all three rivals fit all five canonical pairs, disagree on this generated witness, and are refuted at every cyclic lesson start (`checks/semantic-probe-v2.json`).
